title: Psychic detective to speak at writers meeting
excerpt: How does a psychic detective communicate intuitive information to investigators, and what responsibilities come with that work? Psychic detective and author Pam Coronado will explore those questions …
content:
How does a psychic detective communicate intuitive information to investigators, and what responsibilities come with that work? Psychic detective and author Pam Coronado will explore those questions at the Northeast Florida Sisters in Crime November meeting.

Coronado will present “When Intuition Meets Investigation: A Discussion with Pam Coronado” at 10:15 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7. She will discuss what intuitive information can offer, how she shares it with investigators and the responsibilities involved. A question-and-answer session will follow.

A star of the television series “Sensing Murder,” Coronado has been involved in psychic detective work since 1996. An advocate for victims and their families, she is also search-and-rescue certified and provides training for people interested in assisting with psychic detective work. She is a former president and vice president of the International Remote Viewing Association.

The program is free and open to all writers and readers interested in the topic. Participants may join via Zoom from home or gather at the Ponte Vedra Beach Library to watch the Zoom presentation together. Coronado will present remotely.

Register for the Zoom link at https://bit.ly/3Ul6zm0.

To attend online with the group, go to Ponte Vedra Beach Library, the Glass Room, 101 Library Blvd.

Northeast Florida Sisters in Crime is a chapter of the national organization and serves mystery, crime and thriller writers and readers. Programs feature speakers in forensic science, psychology and law enforcement fields.

For more information, contact floridasistersincrime@gmail.com.
